pw.tip: Tip: a passphrase of several random words is long and easy to remember. A password manager is ideal.

rc.confirm: I have stored my login ID and recovery codes safely.
rc.noEmail: Without email there is no other way back.
rc.warning: If you forget your password and lose these codes, your account is lost for good – not even the administration can restore it. Keep the codes separate from the device (password manager or paper).
